message_text: I got a parking ticket on campus but I have a valid permit. How do I appeal?
You can appeal parking tickets online through the Parking Services portal within 14 days of the ticket date. Upload a photo of your valid permit as evidence.
Where is the parking services portal? I can't find it.
Go to university.edu/parking and click 'Citation Appeal'. You'll need your ticket number and student ID.
Found it. Thanks. This should be easier to find on the main site though.
Agreed, and thank you for the feedback. Good luck with your appeal!
